crossRefs.note: Jesus went about in all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing…
The report about him went out into all Syria. They brought to him all who were sick, afflicted with various diseases…
When Jesus returned, the multitude welcomed him, for they were all waiting for him.
The Passover of the Jews was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
Now when he was in Jerusalem at the Passover, during the feast, many believed in his name, observing his signs which he…
The same came to him by night, and said to him, “Rabbi, we know that you are a teacher come from God, for no one can do…
Three times in a year all of your males shall appear before Yahweh your God in the place which he chooses: in the feast…
When he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem according to the custom of the feast,
They didn’t receive him, because he was traveling with his face set toward Jerusalem.

people.name: Galilee
people.line: Region in northern Israel; key location in Jesus' ministry

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: So when he came into Galilee, the Galileans received him, having seen all the things that he did in Jerusalem at the feast, for they also went to the feast.
translations.bsb: Yet when He arrived, the Galileans welcomed Him. They had seen all the great things He had done in Jerusalem at the feast, for they had gone there as well.
translations.kjv: Then when he was come into Galilee, the Galilaeans received him, having seen all the things that he did at Jerusalem at the feast: for they also went unto the feast.
translations.asv: So when he came into Galilee, the Galilaeans received him, having seen all the things that he did in Jerusalem at the feast: for they also went unto the feast.
